valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E, forward period viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027) taken as FY2028 (July 2028) non-GAAP diluted EPS. Anchor: FY2027 guidance of revenue $23.28-23.51B (+9-10%) and non-GAAP EPS $22.88-$23.12; from Aug 1 2026 Intuit no longer excludes share-based compensation, so this is not comparable with FY2026 $24.27. FY2028 EPS is my own assumption: bear $22.50, base $25.50 (about 10% growth), bull $28.00. Per share of the USD Nasdaq listing; no ADR or FX conversion applies.

bear.driver: AI disruption of TurboTax and small-business software caps growth at mid single digits and the multiple compresses

base.driver: Revenue grows 9-10% as guided, consumer recovers slowly, buybacks add to EPS

bull.driver: Mailchimp/QuickBooks AI-led growth re-accelerates revenue toward low double digits and the multiple re-rates

valuation.implied_by_close: At FY2027 guide midpoint EPS $23.00 the close of $341.70 implies 14.9x; at base FY2028 EPS $25.50 it implies 13.4x. The named Aug-2026 targets average about $337 (range $290-$430), which is 13.2x base EPS, or EPS $22.5 at 15x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $25.50 (7.5% of the close).
valuation.watch_metric: Consumer/TurboTax revenue growth against the 4-6% guide and non-GAAP operating margin on the new SBC-inclusive basis.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q1 FY2027 results (guide: revenue $4.294-4.313B, EPS $2.44-$2.48), expected late November 2026.

analyst_notes: After the Aug 25 FY2027 guide, firms cut targets: Morgan Stanley $315 from $335, JPMorgan downgraded to Neutral at $331, Piper Sandler $290; Truist held at $350 (from $410) before results and Mizuho stayed Outperform at $430. Targets average about $337, near the close and below the $382 base, a gap equal to roughly 1.5 turns of P/E or about $2.5 of EPS. No horizon is documented, so none enters the weighted target; the sample is thin, comes from aggregators, and some figures conflict across sources.
